title: Gmail-Style Offline Email Client Frontend System Design
description: Design an offline-first web email client with normalized mailbox state, incremental sync, durable drafts, idempotent sending, safe message rendering, and accessible navigation.

sections.title: Data model, drafts, and queued intent
Interface contracts for sync and sending
Optimizations for performance, security, and accessibility

seo.title: Gmail Frontend System Design: Offline Email Client
seo.description: Design an offline email client with incremental mailbox sync, IndexedDB caching, durable drafts, idempotent sends, safe HTML, and accessible navigation.

editorial.searchIntent: Learn how to design an offline-first web email client that reconciles mailbox sync, local drafts, and send outcomes.
editorial.readerPromise: The reader can design a normalized, offline-capable email UI with explicit cache, outbox, security, and accessibility boundaries.
editorial.uniqueAngle: Treat the mailbox as a server-authoritative projection cached locally while drafts and outbox commands remain durable user intent until they reconcile with sync.
